checks.expectation: Bind final published source/remote/branch/index/runtime/recorder/validator identities; a337 preparation is not final authorization.
Exact original four-job push CI and clean package/strict/artifact gates precede each phase; bind actual logs/artifacts.
Check full source/gate bytes before and after each command, including final slot; missing poststate fails.
Fixed command/phase/slot, exclusive reservation, bounded subprocess and outputs; preserve all failures without retry.
Strict closed canonical <=2MiB stdout and persisted byte equality; separately observable returned artifact only if actually captured once.
Exit/status/reason table and both inner/outer cleanup; COMPLETE negative C exits0 but remains NO_GO.
Two distinct command/reservation slots, same source/binding producer and exact full public bytes; no deletion-based normalization.
Authenticate A/B original producers and ordered lineage; each B embedded A equals C A; C binding remains identical across pair.
Complete A manifest/role shape and explicit literal-name exposure; no semantic inference from names.
B complete bounded cell partition, exposure/SST disclosure, A replay; semantic safety/freshness unestablished.
Completed historical counter equations A/B and same-source pair only; never full C or failure prefixes.
C public counts/modes/rows/binding consistency, structural no-values, strict-or-not-requested documentary state, mandatory negative/vacuity rules.
Root alone freezes dependent pins; no auto phase advance, at most2x3, no actual strict-B fourth phase or adaptive second C.
Review distinguishes public consistency/byte identity from raw recomputation, authenticity of arbitrary receipts and scientific truth.

return_observation_limit: Under reviewed CLI, stdout is canonical serialization of inspect return after final close; no separately captured third return channel is implied. Any separate return artifact must be captured in the same single invocation.
